title: Revelation of John 11:19
text: And the temple of God in the heaven was opened, and the ark of his covenant was seen in his temple: and there were lightnings, and voices, and thunders, and an earthquake, and great hail.

title: Revelation of John 12:1
text: ¶And a great sign was seen in the heaven: a woman clothed with the sun, and the moon under her feet, and upon her head a crown of twelve stars;

title: Revelation of John 12:2
text: and being with child she cried, [being] in travail, and in pain to bring forth.

title: Revelation of John 12:3
text: And another sign was seen in the heaven: and behold, a great red dragon, having seven heads and ten horns, and on his heads seven diadems;

title: Revelation of John 12:4
text: and his tail draws the third part of the stars of the heaven; and he cast them to the earth. And the dragon stood before the woman who was about to bring forth, in order that when she brought forth he might devour her child.

title: Revelation of John 12:5
text: And she brought forth a male son, who shall shepherd all the nations with an iron rod; and her child was caught up to God and to his throne.

title: Revelation of John 12:6
text: And the woman fled into the wilderness, where she has there a place prepared of God, that they should nourish her there a thousand two hundred [and] sixty days.

title: Revelation of John 12:7
text: And there was war in the heaven: Michael and his angels went to war with the dragon. And the dragon fought, and his angels;

title: Revelation of John 12:8
text: and he prevailed not, nor was their place found any more in the heaven.

title: Revelation of John 12:9
text: And the great dragon was cast out, the ancient serpent, he who is called Devil and Satan, he who deceives the whole habitable world, he was cast out into the earth, and his angels were cast out with him.

title: Revelation of John 12:10
text: And I heard a great voice in the heaven saying, Now is come the salvation and the power and the kingdom of our God, and the authority of his Christ; for the accuser of our brethren has been cast out, who accused them before our God day and night:

title: Revelation of John 12:11
text: and *they* have overcome him by reason of the blood of the Lamb, and by reason of the word of their testimony, and have not loved their life even unto death.

title: Revelation of John 12:12
text: ¶Therefore be full of delight, ye heavens, and ye that dwell in them. Woe to the earth and to the sea, because the devil has come down to you, having great rage, knowing he has a short time.

title: Revelation of John 12:13
text: And when the dragon saw that he had been cast out into the earth, he persecuted the woman which bore the male [child].

title: Revelation of John 12:14
text: And there were given to the woman the two wings of the great eagle, that she might fly into the desert into her place, where she is nourished there a time, and times, and half a time, from [the] face of the serpent.

title: Revelation of John 12:15
text: And the serpent cast out of his mouth behind the woman water as a river, that he might make her be [as] one carried away by a river.

title: Revelation of John 12:16
text: And the earth helped the woman, and the earth opened its mouth and swallowed the river which the dragon cast out of his mouth.

title: Revelation of John 12:17
text: And the dragon was angry with the woman, and went to make war with the remnant of her seed, who keep the commandments of God, and have the testimony of Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 13:1
text: ¶And I stood upon the sand of the sea; and I saw a beast rising out of the sea, having ten horns and seven heads, and upon its horns ten diadems, and upon its heads names of blasphemy.

title: Revelation of John 13:2
text: And the beast which I saw was like to a leopardess, and its feet as of a bear, and its mouth as a lion's mouth; and the dragon gave to it his power, and his throne, and great authority;

title: Revelation of John 13:3
text: and one of his heads [was] as slain to death, and his wound of death had been healed: and the whole earth wondered after the beast.

title: Revelation of John 13:4
text: And they did homage to the dragon, because he gave the authority to the beast; and they did homage to the beast, saying, Who [is] like to the beast? and who can make war with it?

title: Revelation of John 13:5
text: And there was given to it a mouth, speaking great things and blasphemies; and there was given to it authority to pursue its career forty-two months.

title: Revelation of John 13:6
text: And it opened its mouth for blasphemies against God, to blaspheme his name and his tabernacle, and those who have their tabernacle in the heaven.

title: Revelation of John 13:7
text: And there was given to it to make war with the saints, and to overcome them; and there was given to it authority over every tribe, and people, and tongue, and nation;

title: Revelation of John 13:8
text: and all that dwell on the earth shall do it homage, [every one] whose name had not been written from [the] founding of [the] world in the book of life of the slain Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 13:9
text: If any one has an ear, let him hear.

title: Revelation of John 13:10
text: If any one [leads] into captivity, he goes into captivity. If any one shall kill with [the] sword, he must with [the] sword be killed. Here is the endurance and the faith of the saints.

title: Revelation of John 13:11
text: ¶And I saw another beast rising out of the earth; and it had two horns like to a lamb, and spake as a dragon;

title: Revelation of John 13:12
text: and it exercises all the authority of the first beast before it, and causes the earth and those that dwell in it to do homage to the first beast, whose wound of death was healed.

title: Revelation of John 13:13
text: And it works great signs, that it should cause even fire to come down from heaven to the earth before men.

title: Revelation of John 13:14
text: And it deceives those that dwell upon the earth by reason of the signs which it was given to it to work before the beast, saying to those that dwell upon the earth to make an image to the beast, which has the wound of the sword, and lived.

title: Revelation of John 13:15
text: And it was given to it to give breath to the image of the beast, that the image of the beast should also speak, and should cause that as many as should not do homage to the image of the beast should be killed.

title: Revelation of John 13:16
text: And it causes all, the small and the great, and the rich and the poor, and the free and the bondmen, that they should give them a mark upon their right hand or upon their forehead;

title: Revelation of John 13:17
text: and that no one should be able to buy or sell save he that had the mark, the name of the beast, or the number of its name.

title: Revelation of John 13:18
text: Here is wisdom. He that has understanding let him count the number of the beast: for it is a man's number; and its number [is] six hundred [and] sixty-six.

title: Revelation of John 14:1
text: ¶And I saw, and behold, the Lamb standing upon mount Zion, and with him a hundred [and] forty-four thousand, having his name and the name of his Father written upon their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 14:2
text: And I heard a voice out of the heaven as a voice of many waters, and as a voice of great thunder. And the voice which I heard [was] as of harp-singers harping with their harps;

title: Revelation of John 14:3
text: and they sing a new song before the throne, and before the four living creatures and the elders. And no one could learn that song save the hundred [and] forty-four thousand who were bought from the earth.

title: Revelation of John 14:4
text: These are they who have not been defiled with women, for they are virgins: these are they who follow the Lamb wheresoever it goes. These have been bought from men [as] first-fruits to God and to the Lamb:

title: Revelation of John 14:5
text: and in their mouths was no lie found; [for] they are blameless.

title: Revelation of John 14:6
text: ¶And I saw another angel flying in mid-heaven, having [the] everlasting glad tidings to announce to those settled on the earth, and to every nation and tribe and tongue and people,

title: Revelation of John 14:7
text: saying with a loud voice, Fear God and give him glory, for the hour of his judgment has come; and do homage to him who has made the heaven and the earth and the sea and fountains of waters.

title: Revelation of John 14:8
text: And another, a second, angel followed, saying, Great Babylon has fallen, has fallen, which of the wine of the fury of her fornication has made all nations drink.

title: Revelation of John 14:9
text: And another, a third, angel followed them, saying with a loud voice, If any one do homage to the beast and its image, and receive a mark upon his forehead or upon his hand,

title: Revelation of John 14:10
text: he also shall drink of the wine of the fury of God prepared unmixed in the cup of his wrath, and he shall be tormented in fire and brimstone before the holy angels and before the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 14:11
text: And the smoke of their torment goes up to ages of ages, and they have no respite day and night who do homage to the beast and to its image, and if any one receive the mark of its name.

title: Revelation of John 14:12
text: Here is the endurance of the saints, who keep the commandments of God and the faith of Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 14:13
text: ¶And I heard a voice out of the heaven saying, Write, Blessed the dead who die in [the] Lord from henceforth. Yea, saith the Spirit, that they may rest from their labours; for their works follow with them.

title: Revelation of John 14:14
text: And I saw, and behold, a white cloud, and on the cloud one sitting like [the] Son of man, having upon his head a golden crown, and in his hand a sharp sickle.

title: Revelation of John 14:15
text: And another angel came out of the temple, crying with a loud voice to him that sat on the cloud, Send thy sickle and reap; for the hour of reaping is come, for the harvest of the earth is dried.

title: Revelation of John 14:16
text: And he that sat on the cloud put his sickle on the earth, and the earth was reaped.

title: Revelation of John 14:17
text: And another angel came out of the temple which [is] in the heaven, he also having a sharp sickle.

title: Revelation of John 14:18
text: And another angel came out of the altar, having power over fire, and called with a loud cry to him that had the sharp sickle, saying, Send thy sharp sickle, and gather the bunches of the vine of the earth; for her grapes are fully ripened.

title: Revelation of John 14:19
text: And the angel put his sickle to the earth, and gathered the vine of the earth, and cast [the bunches] into the great wine-press of the fury of God;

title: Revelation of John 14:20
text: and the wine-press was trodden without the city, and blood went out of the wine-press to the bits of the horses for a thousand six hundred stadia.

title: Revelation of John 15:1
text: ¶And I saw another sign in the heaven, great and wonderful: seven angels having seven plagues, the last; for in them the fury of God is completed.

title: Revelation of John 15:2
text: And I saw as a glass sea, mingled with fire, and those that had gained the victory over the beast, and over its image, and over the number of its name, standing upon the glass sea, having harps of God.

title: Revelation of John 15:3
text: And they sing the song of Moses bondman of God, and the song of the Lamb, saying, Great and wonderful [are] thy works, Lord God Almighty; righteous and true [are] thy ways, O King of nations.

title: Revelation of John 15:4
text: Who shall not fear [thee], O Lord, and glorify thy name? for [thou] only [art] holy; for all nations shall come and do homage before thee; for thy righteousnesses have been made manifest.

title: Revelation of John 15:5
text: ¶And after these things I saw, and the temple of the tabernacle of witness in the heaven was opened;

title: Revelation of John 15:6
text: and the seven angels who had the seven plagues came out of the temple, clothed in pure bright linen, and girded about the breasts with golden girdles.

title: Revelation of John 15:7
text: And one of the four living creatures gave to the seven angels seven golden bowls, full of the fury of God, who lives to the ages of ages.

title: Revelation of John 15:8
text: And the temple was filled with smoke from the glory of God and from his power: and no one could enter into the temple until the seven plagues of the seven angels were completed.

title: Revelation of John 16:1
text: ¶And I heard a great voice out of the temple, saying to the seven angels, Go and pour out the seven bowls of the fury of God upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 16:2
text: And the first went and poured out his bowl on the earth; and there came an evil and grievous sore upon the men that had the mark of the beast, and those who worshipped its image.

title: Revelation of John 16:3
text: And the second poured out his bowl on the sea; and it became blood, as of a dead man; and every living soul died in the sea.

title: Revelation of John 16:4
text: And the third poured out his bowl on the rivers, and [on] the fountains of waters; and they became blood.

title: Revelation of John 16:5
text: And I heard the angel of the waters saying, Thou art righteous, who art and wast, the holy one, that thou hast judged so;

title: Revelation of John 16:6
text: for they have poured out the blood of saints and prophets, and thou hast given them blood to drink; they are worthy.

title: Revelation of John 16:7
text: And I heard the altar saying, Yea, Lord God Almighty, true and righteous [are] thy judgments.

title: Revelation of John 16:8
text: ¶And the fourth poured out his bowl on the sun; and it was given to it to burn men with fire.

title: Revelation of John 16:9
text: And the men were burnt with great heat, and blasphemed the name of God, who had authority over these plagues, and did not repent to give him glory.

title: Revelation of John 16:10
text: And the fifth poured out his bowl on the throne of the beast; and its kingdom became darkened; and they gnawed their tongues with distress,

title: Revelation of John 16:11
text: and blasphemed the God of the heaven for their distresses and their sores, and did not repent of their works.

title: Revelation of John 16:12
text: ¶And the sixth poured out his bowl on the great river Euphrates; and its water was dried up, that the way of the kings from the rising of the sun might be prepared.

title: Revelation of John 16:13
text: And I saw out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet, three unclean spirits, as frogs;

title: Revelation of John 16:14
text: for they are [the] spirits of demons, doing signs; which go out to the kings of the whole habitable world to gather them together to the war of [that] great day of God the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 16:15
text: (Behold, I come as a thief. Blessed [is] he that watches and keeps his garments, that he may not walk naked, and that they [may not] see his shame.)

title: Revelation of John 16:16
text: And he gathered them together to the place called in Hebrew, Armagedon.

title: Revelation of John 16:17
text: ¶And the seventh poured out his bowl on the air; and there came out a great voice from the temple of the heaven, from the throne, saying, It is done.

title: Revelation of John 16:18
text: And there were lightnings, and voices, and thunders; and there was a great earthquake, such as was not since men were upon the earth, such an earthquake, so great.

title: Revelation of John 16:19
text: And the great city was [divided] into three parts; and the cities of the nations fell: and great Babylon was remembered before God to give her the cup of the wine of the fury of his wrath.

title: Revelation of John 16:20
text: And every island fled, and mountains were not found;

title: Revelation of John 16:21
text: and a great hail, as of a talent weight, comes down out of the heaven upon men; and men blasphemed God because of the plague of hail, for the plague of it is exceeding great.

title: Revelation of John 17:1
text: ¶And one of the seven angels, which had the seven bowls, came and spoke with me, saying, Come here, I will shew thee the sentence of the great harlot who sits upon the many waters;

title: Revelation of John 17:2
text: with whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication; and they that dwell on the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.

title: Revelation of John 17:3
text: And he carried me away in spirit to a desert; and I saw a woman sitting upon a scarlet beast, full of names of blasphemy, having seven heads and ten horns.

title: Revelation of John 17:4
text: And the woman was clothed in purple and scarlet, and had ornaments of gold and precious stones and pearls, having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and the unclean things of her fornication;

title: Revelation of John 17:5
text: and upon her forehead a name written, Mystery, great Babylon, the mother of the harlots, and of the abominations of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 17:6
text: And I saw the woman drunk with the blood of the saints, and with the blood of the witnesses of Jesus. And I wondered, seeing her, with great wonder.

title: Revelation of John 17:7
text: ¶And the angel said to me, Why hast thou wondered? *I* will tell thee the mystery of the woman, and of the beast which carries her, which has the seven heads and the ten horns.

title: Revelation of John 17:8
text: The beast which thou sawest was, and is not, and is about to come up out of the abyss and go into destruction: and they who dwell on the earth, whose names are not written from the founding of the world in the book of life, shall wonder, seeing the beast, that it was, and is not, and shall be present.

title: Revelation of John 17:9
text: Here is the mind that has wisdom: The seven heads are seven mountains, whereon the woman sits.

title: Revelation of John 17:10
text: And there are seven kings: five have fallen, one is, the other has not yet come; and when he comes he must remain [only] a little while.

title: Revelation of John 17:11
text: And the beast that was and is not, he also is an eighth, and is of the seven, and goes into destruction.

title: Revelation of John 17:12
text: And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings, which have not yet received a kingdom, but receive authority as kings one hour with the beast.

title: Revelation of John 17:13
text: These have one mind, and give their power and authority to the beast.

title: Revelation of John 17:14
text: ¶These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them; for he is Lord of lords and King of kings: and they [that are] with him called, and chosen, and faithful.

title: Revelation of John 17:15
text: And he says to me, The waters which thou sawest, where the harlot sits, are peoples and multitudes and nations and tongues.

title: Revelation of John 17:16
text: And the ten horns which thou sawest, and the beast, these shall hate the harlot, and shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and shall burn her with fire;

title: Revelation of John 17:17
text: for God has given to their hearts to do his mind, and to act with one mind, and to give their kingdom to the beast until the words of God shall be fulfilled.

title: Revelation of John 17:18
text: And the woman which thou sawest is the great city, which has kingship over the kings of the earth.

title: Revelation of John 18:1
text: ¶After these things I saw another angel descending out of the heaven, having great authority: and the earth was lightened with his glory.

title: Revelation of John 18:2
text: And he cried with a strong voice, saying, Great Babylon has fallen, has fallen, and has become the habitation of demons, and a hold of every unclean spirit, and a hold of every unclean and hated bird;

title: Revelation of John 18:3
text: because all the nations have drunk of the wine of the fury of her fornication; and the kings of the earth have committed fornication with her, and the merchants of the earth have been enriched through the might of her luxury.

title: Revelation of John 18:4
text: And I heard another voice out of the heaven saying, Come out of her, my people, that ye have not fellowship in her sins, and that ye do not receive of her plagues:

title: Revelation of John 18:5
text: for her sins have been heaped on one another up to the heaven, and God has remembered her unrighteousnesses.

title: Revelation of John 18:6
text: Recompense her even as she has recompensed; and double [to her] double, according to her works. In the cup which she has mixed, mix to her double.

title: Revelation of John 18:7
text: So much as she has glorified herself and lived luxuriously, so much torment and grief give to her. Because she says in her heart, I sit a queen, and I am not a widow; and I shall in no wise see grief:

title: Revelation of John 18:8
text: for this reason in one day shall her plagues come, death and grief and famine, and she shall be burnt with fire; for strong [is the] Lord God who has judged her.

title: Revelation of John 18:9
text: ¶And the kings of the earth, who have committed fornication, and lived luxuriously with her, shall weep and wail over her, when they see the smoke of her burning,

title: Revelation of John 18:10
text: standing afar off, through fear of her torment, saying, Woe, woe, the great city, Babylon, the strong city! for in one hour thy judgment is come.

title: Revelation of John 18:11
text: And the merchants of the earth weep and grieve over her, because no one buys their lading any more;

title: Revelation of John 18:12
text: lading of gold, and silver, and precious stones, and pearl, and fine linen, and purple, and silk, and scarlet dye, and all thyine wood, and every article in ivory, and every article in most precious wood, and in brass, and in iron, and in marble,

title: Revelation of John 18:13
text: and cinnamon, and amomum, and incense, and unguent, and frankincense, and wine, and oil, and fine flour, and wheat, and cattle, and sheep, and of horses, and of chariots, and of bodies, and souls of men.

title: Revelation of John 18:14
text: And the ripe fruits which were the lust of thy soul have departed from thee, and all fair and splendid things have perished from thee, and they shall not find them any more at all.

title: Revelation of John 18:15
text: The merchants of these things, who had been enriched through her, shall stand afar off through fear of her torment, weeping and grieving,

title: Revelation of John 18:16
text: saying, Woe, woe, the great city, which [was] clothed with fine linen and purple and scarlet, and had ornaments of gold and precious stones and pearls!

title: Revelation of John 18:17
text: for in one hour so great riches has been made desolate. And every steersman, and every one who sailed to any place, and sailors, and all who exercise their calling on the sea, stood afar off,

title: Revelation of John 18:18
text: and cried, seeing the smoke of her burning, saying, What [city] is like to the great city?

title: Revelation of John 18:19
text: and cast dust upon their heads, and cried, weeping and grieving, saying, Woe, woe, the great city, in which all that had ships in the sea were enriched through her costliness! for in one hour she has been made desolate.

title: Revelation of John 18:20
text: Rejoice over her, heaven, and [ye] saints and apostles and prophets; for God has judged your judgment upon her.

title: Revelation of John 18:21
text: And a strong angel took up a stone, as a great millstone, and cast [it] into the sea, saying, Thus with violence shall Babylon the great city be cast down, and shall be found no more at all;

title: Revelation of John 18:22
text: and voice of harp-singers and musicians and flute-players and trumpeters shall not be heard any more at all in thee, and no artificer of any art shall be found any more at all in thee, and voice of millstone shall be heard no more at all in thee,

title: Revelation of John 18:23
text: and light of lamp shall shine no more at all in thee, and voice of bridegroom and bride shall be heard no more at all in thee; for thy merchants were the great ones of the earth; for by thy sorcery have all the nations been deceived.

title: Revelation of John 18:24
text: And in her was found [the] blood of prophets and saints, and of all the slain upon the earth.

title: Revelation of John 19:1
text: ¶After these things I heard as a loud voice of a great multitude in the heaven, saying, Hallelujah: the salvation and the glory and the power of our God:

title: Revelation of John 19:2
text: for true and righteous [are] his judgments; for he has judged the great harlot which corrupted the earth with her fornication, and has avenged the blood of his bondmen at her hand.

title: Revelation of John 19:3
text: And a second time they said, Hallelujah. And her smoke goes up to the ages of ages.

title: Revelation of John 19:4
text: And the twenty-four elders and the four living creatures fell down and did homage to God who sits upon the throne, saying, Amen, Hallelujah.

title: Revelation of John 19:5
text: ¶And a voice came out of the throne, saying, Praise our God, all ye his bondmen, [and] ye that fear him, small and great.

title: Revelation of John 19:6
text: And I heard as a voice of a great crowd, and as a voice of many waters, and as a voice of strong thunders, saying, Hallelujah, for [the] Lord our God the Almighty has taken to himself kingly power.

title: Revelation of John 19:7
text: Let us rejoice and exult, and give him glory; for the marriage of the Lamb is come, and his wife has made herself ready.

title: Revelation of John 19:8
text: And it was given to her that she should be clothed in fine linen, bright [and] pure; for the fine linen is the righteousnesses of the saints.

title: Revelation of John 19:9
text: And he says to me, Write, Blessed [are] they who are called to the supper of the marriage of the Lamb. And he says to me, These are the true words of God.

title: Revelation of John 19:10
text: And I fell before his feet to do him homage. And he says to me, See [thou do it] not. I am thy fellow-bondman, and [the fellow-bondman] of thy brethren who have the testimony of Jesus. Do homage to God. For the spirit of prophecy is the testimony of Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 19:11
text: ¶And I saw the heaven opened, and behold, a white horse, and one sitting on it, [called] Faithful and True, and he judges and makes war in righteousness.

title: Revelation of John 19:12
text: And his eyes are a flame of fire, and upon his head many diadems, having a name written which no one knows but himself;

title: Revelation of John 19:13
text: and [he is] clothed with a garment dipped in blood; and his name is called The Word of God.

title: Revelation of John 19:14
text: And the armies which [are] in the heaven followed him upon white horses, clad in white, pure, fine linen.

title: Revelation of John 19:15
text: And out of his mouth goes a sharp [two-edged] sword, that with it he might smite the nations; and he shall shepherd them with an iron rod; and he treads the wine-press of the fury of the wrath of God the Almighty.

title: Revelation of John 19:16
text: And he has upon his garment, and upon his thigh, a name written, King of kings, and Lord of lords.

title: Revelation of John 19:17
text: And I saw an angel standing in the sun; and he cried with a loud voice, saying to all the birds that fly in mid-heaven, Come, gather yourselves to the great supper of God,

title: Revelation of John 19:18
text: that ye may eat flesh of kings, and flesh of chiliarchs, and flesh of strong men, and flesh of horses and of those that sit upon them, and flesh of all, both free and bond, and small and great.

title: Revelation of John 19:19
text: And I saw the beast and the kings of the earth and their armies gathered together to make war against him that sat upon the horse, and against his army.

title: Revelation of John 19:20
text: And the beast was taken, and the false prophet that [was] with him, who wrought the signs before him by which he deceived them that received the mark of the beast, and those that worship his image. Alive were both cast into the lake of fire which burns with brimstone;

title: Revelation of John 19:21
text: and the rest were slain with the sword of him that sat upon the horse, which goes out of his mouth; and all the birds were filled with their flesh.

title: Revelation of John 20:1
text: ¶And I saw an angel descending from the heaven, having the key of the abyss, and a great chain in his hand.

title: Revelation of John 20:2
text: And he laid hold of the dragon, the ancient serpent who is [the] devil and Satan, and bound him a thousand years,

title: Revelation of John 20:3
text: and cast him into the abyss, and shut [it] and sealed [it] over him, that he should not any more deceive the nations until the thousand years were completed; after these things he must be loosed for a little time.

title: Revelation of John 20:4
text: And I saw thrones; and they sat upon them, and judgment was given to them; and the souls of those beheaded on account of the testimony of Jesus, and on account of the word of God; and those who had not done homage to the beast nor to his image, and had not received the mark on their forehead and hand; and they lived and reigned with the Christ a thousand years:

title: Revelation of John 20:5
text: the rest of the dead did not live till the thousand years had been completed. This [is] the first resurrection.

title: Revelation of John 20:6
text: Blessed and holy he who has part in the first resurrection: over these the second death has no power; but they shall be priests of God and of the Christ, and shall reign with him a thousand years.

title: Revelation of John 20:7
text: And when the thousand years have been completed, Satan shall be loosed from his prison,

title: Revelation of John 20:8
text: and shall go out to deceive the nations which [are] in the four corners of the earth, Gog and Magog, to gather them together to the war, whose number [is] as the sand of the sea.

title: Revelation of John 20:9
text: And they went up on the breadth of the earth, and surrounded the camp of the saints and the beloved city: and fire came down [from God] out of the heaven and devoured them.

title: Revelation of John 20:10
text: And the devil who deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where [are] both the beast and the false prophet; and they shall be tormented day and night for the ages of ages.

title: Revelation of John 20:11
text: ¶And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled, and place was not found for them.

title: Revelation of John 20:12
text: And I saw the dead, great and small, standing before the throne, and books were opened; and another book was opened, which is [that] of life. And the dead were judged out of the things written in the books according to their works.

title: Revelation of John 20:13
text: And the sea gave up the dead which [were] in it, and death and hades gave up the dead which [were] in them; and they were judged each according to their works:

title: Revelation of John 20:14
text: and death and hades were cast into the lake of fire. This is the second death, [even] the lake of fire.

title: Revelation of John 20:15
text: And if any one was not found written in the book of life, he was cast into the lake of fire.

title: Revelation of John 21:1
text: ¶And I saw a new heaven and a new earth; for the first heaven and the first earth had passed away, and the sea exists no more.

title: Revelation of John 21:2
text: And I saw the holy city, new Jerusalem, coming down out of the heaven from God, prepared as a bride adorned for her husband.

title: Revelation of John 21:3
text: And I heard a loud voice out of the heaven, saying, Behold, the tabernacle of God [is] with men, and he shall tabernacle with them, and they shall be his people, and God himself shall be with them, their God.

title: Revelation of John 21:4
text: And he shall wipe away every tear from their eyes; and death shall not exist any more, nor grief, nor cry, nor distress shall exist any more, for the former things have passed away.

title: Revelation of John 21:5
text: And he that sat on the throne said, Behold, I make all things new. And he says [to me], Write, for these words are true and faithful.

title: Revelation of John 21:6
text: And he said to me, It is done. I am the Alpha and the Omega, the beginning and the end. I will give to him that thirsts of the fountain of the water of life freely.

title: Revelation of John 21:7
text: He that overcomes shall inherit these things, and I will be to him God, and he shall be to me son.

title: Revelation of John 21:8
text: But to the fearful and unbelieving, [and sinners], and those who make themselves abominable, and murderers, and fornicators, and sorcerers, and idolaters, and all liars, their part [is] in the lake which burns with fire and brimstone; which is the second death.

title: Revelation of John 21:9
text: ¶And there came one of the seven angels which had had the seven bowls full of the seven last plagues, and spoke with me, saying, Come here, I will shew thee the bride, the Lamb's wife.

title: Revelation of John 21:10
text: And he carried me away in [the] Spirit, [and set me] on a great and high mountain, and shewed me the holy city, Jerusalem, coming down out of the heaven from God,

title: Revelation of John 21:11
text: having the glory of God. Her shining [was] like a most precious stone, as a crystal-like jasper stone;

title: Revelation of John 21:12
text: having a great and high wall; having twelve gates, and at the gates twelve angels, and names inscribed, which are those of the twelve tribes of [the] sons of Israel.

title: Revelation of John 21:13
text: On [the] east three gates; and on [the] north three gates; and on [the] south three gates; and on [the] west three gates.

title: Revelation of John 21:14
text: And the wall of the city had twelve foundations, and on them twelve names of the twelve apostles of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 21:15
text: And he that spoke with me had a golden reed [as] a measure, that he might measure the city, and its gates, and its wall.

title: Revelation of John 21:16
text: And the city lies four-square, and its length [is] as much as the breadth. And he measured the city with the reed--twelve thousand stadia: the length and the breadth and height of it are equal.

title: Revelation of John 21:17
text: And he measured its wall, a hundred [and] forty-four cubits, [a] man's measure, that is, [the] angel's.

title: Revelation of John 21:18
text: And the building of its wall [was] jasper; and the city pure gold, like pure glass:

title: Revelation of John 21:19
text: the foundations of the wall of the city [were] adorned with every precious stone: the first foundation, jasper; the second, sapphire; the third, chalcedony; the fourth, emerald;

title: Revelation of John 21:20
text: the fifth, sardonyx; the sixth, sardius; the seventh, chrysolite; the eighth, beryl; the ninth, topaz; the tenth, chrysoprasus; the eleventh, jacinth; the twelfth, amethyst.

title: Revelation of John 21:21
text: And the twelve gates, twelve pearls; each one of the gates, respectively, was of one pearl; and the street of the city pure gold, as transparent glass.

title: Revelation of John 21:22
text: And I saw no temple in it; for the Lord God Almighty is its temple, and the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 21:23
text: And the city has no need of the sun nor of the moon, that they should shine for it; for the glory of God has enlightened it, and the lamp thereof [is] the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 21:24
text: And the nations shall walk by its light; and the kings of the earth bring their glory to it.

title: Revelation of John 21:25
text: And its gates shall not be shut at all by day, for night shall not be there.

title: Revelation of John 21:26
text: And they shall bring the glory and the honour of the nations to it.

title: Revelation of John 21:27
text: And nothing common, nor that maketh an abomination and a lie, shall at all enter into it; but those only who [are] written in the book of life of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 22:1
text: ¶And he shewed me a river of water of life, bright as crystal, going out of the throne of God and of the Lamb.

title: Revelation of John 22:2
text: In the midst of its street, and of the river, on this side and on that side, [the] tree of life, producing twelve fruits, in each month yielding its fruit; and the leaves of the tree for healing of the nations.

title: Revelation of John 22:3
text: And no curse shall be any more; and the throne of God and of the Lamb shall be in it; and his servants shall serve him,

title: Revelation of John 22:4
text: and they shall see his face; and his name [is] on their foreheads.

title: Revelation of John 22:5
text: And night shall not be any more, and no need of a lamp, and light of [the] sun; for [the] Lord God shall shine upon them, and they shall reign to the ages of ages.

title: Revelation of John 22:6
text: ¶And he said to me, These words [are] faithful and true; and [the] Lord God of the spirits of the prophets has sent his angel to shew to his bondmen the things which must soon come to pass.

title: Revelation of John 22:7
text: And behold, I come quickly. Blessed [is] he who keeps the words of the prophecy of this book.

title: Revelation of John 22:8
text: And I, John, [was] he who heard and saw these things. And when I heard and saw, I fell down to do homage before the feet of the angel who shewed me these things.

title: Revelation of John 22:9
text: And he says to me, See [thou do it] not. I am thy fellow-bondman, and [the fellow-bondman] of thy brethren the prophets, and of those who keep the words of this book. Do homage to God.

title: Revelation of John 22:10
text: And he says to me, Seal not the words of the prophecy of this book. The time is near.

title: Revelation of John 22:11
text: Let him that does unrighteously do unrighteously still; and let the filthy make himself filthy still; and let him that is righteous practise righteousness still; and he that is holy, let him be sanctified still.

title: Revelation of John 22:12
text: Behold, I come quickly, and my reward with me, to render to every one as his work shall be.

title: Revelation of John 22:13
text: *I* [am] the Alpha and the Omega, [the] first and [the] last, the beginning and the end.

title: Revelation of John 22:14
text: Blessed [are] they that wash their robes, that they may have right to the tree of life, and that they should go in by the gates into the city.

title: Revelation of John 22:15
text: Without [are] the dogs, and the sorcerers, and the fornicators, and the murderers, and the idolaters, and every one that loves and makes a lie.

title: Revelation of John 22:16
text: *I* Jesus have sent mine angel to testify these things to you in the assemblies. *I* am the root and offspring of David, the bright [and] morning star.

title: Revelation of John 22:17
text: And the Spirit and the bride say, Come. And let him that hears say, Come. And let him that is athirst come; he that will, let him take [the] water of life freely.

title: Revelation of John 22:18
text: *I* testify to every one who hears the words of the prophecy of this book, If any one shall add to these things, God shall add to him the plagues which are written in this book.

title: Revelation of John 22:19
text: And if any one take from the words of the book of this prophecy, God shall take away his part from the tree of life, and out of the holy city, which are written in this book.

title: Revelation of John 22:20
text: ¶He that testifies these things says, Yea, I come quickly. Amen; come, Lord Jesus.

title: Revelation of John 22:21
text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ [be] with all the saints.
